metrics.churn: Storms are additions plus deletions in that frame.
metrics.pressure: Gold lines are cyclomatic complexity measured at HEAD, scaled by how much of the file existed in the frame.
metrics.rain: Rain marks lines touched by a commit whose subject looks like a bug fix.
metrics.territory: Color is the author who added the most lines in the analyzed window. Author emails are hashed into ids and omitted.
metrics.relief: Teal mist marks edits to tests. A source change that lands in the same commit as a test edit lowers hotspot risk.
